## The Death of the Job Description

Deloitte's 2026 Human Capital Trends report found that 79% of executives believe skills-based talent practices are critical to their future. Yet only 20% have actually made the shift.

### What Is a Skills-Based Organization?

Instead of defining work through rigid job descriptions, skills-based organizations:

- Map all work to discrete skills and capabilities
- Deploy people to projects based on skill match, not title
- Create internal talent marketplaces for skill-based assignments
- Evaluate performance on skill development, not just output

### The Business Case

### How It Changes Hiring

- Job postings become skill requirements : Instead of "Marketing Manager with 5 years experience," you list "content strategy, demand generation, marketing analytics, team leadership"
- Candidate pools expand : When you remove arbitrary requirements (degrees, years of experience), you access 40-60% more qualified candidates
- Assessment replaces screening : Skills assessments and work samples replace resume scanning
- Continuous matching : Tools match internal and external talent to evolving needs. Subscription sourcing aligns naturally with this model

### Implementation Roadmap

Phase 1 (Months 1-3) : Audit critical skills across the organization

Phase 2 (Months 4-6) : Build skills taxonomy and map existing employees

Phase 3 (Months 7-9) : Launch internal talent marketplace pilot

Phase 4 (Months 10-12) : Integrate skills-based hiring into recruitment
